newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sommer promises attractive Telekom yields.
newsitem.headline: Sommer promises attractive Telekom yields.

text.p: Ron Sommer, chief executive of Deutsche Telekom AG, on Monday promised high dividend returns on the newly listed Telekom shares, saying that these would be higher than was usual in the German market.
In a speech prepared for release at a news conference, Sommer said that the company planned to follow a dividend strategy which would be "progressive and unusual by German standards."

He said the company's strategy also called for an increase in profitability and the return on capital together with a reduction in the company's debts of around 100 billion marks ($66.4 billion). ($ = 1.505 German Marks)
